imagePromptConfiguration.npcs:
READ FIRST: if the character's appearance begins with the line MY OWN LOOK, it is a player's own portrait prompt: use everything after that line exactly as written, framing and style included, and nothing below except this: every figure is a clothed adult and nothing is overt.

STYLE LOCK: Gravity Falls TV animation style, the look of the Disney series (2012): a still frame of the show. Line: clean, even dark outlines with simple rounded shapes and slightly exaggerated cartoon proportions. Shading: flat colour with one soft shadow tone, warm small-town palette, eerie night scenes in deep blues and greens. Faces expressive and readable with simple eyes. Background: painted woodland and small-town backgrounds with soft texture behind the figure. It is 2D TV animation: no painterly realism, no photoreal texture, no 3D render. The world: a travelling circus on old country trade roads: painted wagons, a big striped tent, farm towns with leaning church spires, hedgerows and mud, and a dark pine forest at the edge.

Sources, in order: the visual description, then the basic info, then the character's role. A thin record is drawn from its role and place, never from generic beauty: a tamer in a worn ring coat, a farmer in a smock, a mayor in his best coat, a bandit in mud-spattered layers. Every figure is clothed. Adults look like adults.

Person:
Waist-up portrait, face clear of the frame's edges, the place they belong behind them. Clothes of a country fair a long time ago: waistcoats, ring coats, smocks, shawls, top hats. Expression fits the character. No modern clothes, no text.

Creature:
The whole creature in frame, strange and readable, its own habitat behind it, night creatures in their own dark.

Player Character:
The same style lock and framing as Person, drawn with the care of a show's lead: a clear, memorable design.

Default:
Gravity Falls TV animation style, the look of the Disney series (2012), waist-up, a travelling show's world.
imagePromptConfiguration.locations:
STYLE LOCK: background art in the same style as the portraits: Gravity Falls TV animation style, the look of the Disney series (2012). The world: a travelling circus on old country trade roads: painted wagons, a big striped tent, farm towns with leaning church spires, hedgerows and mud, and a dark pine forest at the edge. Wide establishing shot, empty of people, no text or signs.

Interior:
Wagons, tents, taverns and cottages of a country fair long ago, lit by lanterns and stoves.

Exterior:
Muddy roads, hedgerows, farm fields, painted wagons and the striped tent; the Gloamwood's black pines at night.

Default:
Country trade-road scenery, empty of people, no modern things.
imagePromptConfiguration.areas: STYLE LOCK: Gravity Falls TV animation style, the look of the Disney series (2012), a closer view inside the parent location, the same light and season, empty of people, no text.
imagePromptConfiguration.regions: Map art of the trade-road country seen from high above in the style of Gravity Falls TV, the look of the Disney series (2012): patchwork farms, hedgerows, little towns joined by cart tracks, dark pine forest where the wild starts. No modern roads, no text.
imagePromptConfiguration.items: STYLE LOCK: still life in the style of Gravity Falls TV animation style, the look of the Disney series (2012), a single object from a travelling show or a country town long ago, centred and whole in frame, resting on a wagon's boards or a workbench. Soft lantern light. No hands, no people, no text.
